FAQ.title: Everything you want to know.
FAQ.subtitle: Clear answers to the questions we hear most often — from pricing to security, and everything in between.

q1.question: How much does Tamara cost?
q1.answer: Current pricing is in the grid above, with the minutes included and the price per extra minute. All plans have no commitment and can be cancelled anytime from the dashboard.

q2.question: How does the AI talk to my clients?
q2.answer: Tamara speaks with a natural, calm voice in real time, with no choppiness or robotic feel. Clients feel like they're talking to a real receptionist.

q3.question: Does it understand Hebrew?
q3.answer: Yes. Tamara is natively trilingual: French, Hebrew and English. It auto-detects the language from the first words and switches mid-call if the client changes language. No setup needed — it just works.

q4.question: What happens for complex appointments?
q4.answer: If a request goes beyond what Tamara can handle (an unusual request, a difficult caller), she takes down every useful detail and sends you an instant WhatsApp recap. You call the client back already knowing everything.

q5.question: How do I install Tamara on my line?
q5.answer: Two options. Either we provision a dedicated Twilio number for you (included in every plan), or you set up a forward from your existing line — keeping your usual number. Setup takes five minutes from the dashboard, no technician needed.

q6.question: Is my data secure?
q6.answer: Yes. Tamara is GDPR compliant, hosts all data in Europe (Paris and Frankfurt), encrypts communications with TLS 1.3, and never stores raw voice recordings. Transcripts are kept for audit but accessible only to you.

q7.question: Can I cancel?
q7.answer: Anytime, from the dashboard, in one click. No penalties, no term commitment. You leave with your exportable data (contacts, call history, transcripts) if you wish.

q8.question: What if the AI makes a mistake?
q8.answer: Every call generates a complete timestamped transcript, accessible from the dashboard. You see exactly what the agent said and did: appointment created, contact added, WhatsApp recap sent. If something goes wrong, you adjust Tamara's instructions from the dashboard; they apply from the next call.

AdminVoiceProfile.title: Voice profile

turnSensitivity.label: End-of-turn sensitivity
turnSensitivity.what: How quickly Tamara decides the caller has finished speaking.
turnSensitivity.tip: Raise it if Tamara leaves gaps before answering; lower it if she cuts callers off mid-sentence.

bargeIn.label: Caller can interrupt
bargeIn.what: The caller can talk over Tamara: she stops and listens.
bargeIn.tip: Keep it on for natural conversation. Off: Tamara always finishes her sentence before listening.

keyTerms.label: Key terms
keyTerms.what: Names, brands or rare words Tamara must recognise and spell correctly (treatments, streets, products). A recognition hint; it doesn't change what she says.
keyTerms.tip: Add the words Tamara mishears in transcripts, one per entry.

languageHint.label: Language hint
languageHint.what: Language Tamara expects at the start of the call. "Automatic" = the business language. The caller can still switch unless the language is locked.
languageHint.tip: Keep "Automatic" unless your callers almost all open in a different language from the business.

minInterruptionMs.label: Minimum interruption
minInterruptionMs.what: How long the caller must speak before Tamara lets herself be interrupted.
minInterruptionMs.tip: Raise it if a cough or "hmm" cuts Tamara off; lower it if callers struggle to interrupt her.

idleHangupSec.label: Hang up after silence
idleHangupSec.what: Tamara hangs up after this much total silence on the line. The first 10 s of a call never count.
idleHangupSec.tip: Lower it to free forgotten lines quickly; raise it if your customers take time to look something up.

maxDurationMin.label: Maximum call length
maxDurationMin.what: Hard limit on call length: the call ends when it's reached.
maxDurationMin.tip: Protects against stuck lines: pick well above your longest typical call.

pace.label: Speaking pace
pace.what: How fast Tamara speaks. OpenAI applies it as a speed setting; Gemini and Grok follow it as a speaking instruction.
pace.tip: "Slow" for older callers or poor lines; "Fast" for very short exchanges.

pronunciations.label: Pronunciations
pronunciations.what: How Tamara should say specific words (names, acronyms, brands).
pronunciations.tip: Spell it as it sounds: "SPA" → "spa", "Dr Levy" → "doctor Levy".

fillers.label: Filler words
fillers.what: Allows short fillers like "let me check" while Tamara looks something up.
fillers.tip: Keep it on to avoid silences during a calendar lookup; off, she stays silent until she has the answer.

speakingStyle.label: Speaking style
speakingStyle.what: Free-form guidance on tone: warm, sober, upbeat…
speakingStyle.tip: One or two sentences is enough, e.g. "Warm and smiling, short sentences".
speakingStyle.placeholder: e.g. Warm and smiling, short sentences.

languageLock.label: Lock language
languageLock.what: Tamara stays in the account's language even if the caller switches.
languageLock.tip: Turn on if Tamara wrongly switches language on a foreign word; leave off for multilingual customers.

openaiTurnMode.label: Turn detection
openaiTurnMode.what: How OpenAI decides the caller is done: by silence, or by what the sentence means.
openaiTurnMode.tip: "Semantic" cuts hesitant speakers off less; "Silence" reacts faster.

openaiEagerness.label: Eagerness
openaiEagerness.what: In semantic mode, how early Tamara takes her turn.
openaiEagerness.tip: "Low" lets people who think out loud finish; "High" for quick exchanges.

openaiNoiseReduction.label: OpenAI noise reduction
openaiNoiseReduction.what: OpenAI-side noise filter, on top of our own noise reduction.
openaiNoiseReduction.tip: Keep "Off" (our filter is enough); "Far field" helps with speakerphones and cars.

openaiReasoning.label: Reasoning
openaiReasoning.what: OpenAI thinking effort before each answer. "By model" = none on gpt-realtime-2, low on 2.1.
openaiReasoning.tip: Higher = better on complex requests but slower replies; keep "By model" for booking appointments.

noiseReduction.label: Noise reduction
noiseReduction.what: Filters the caller's background noise before Tamara hears it.
noiseReduction.tip: Raise it for calls from the street or a car; lower it if syllables get clipped.

voiceOverrides.label: Exact voice per engine
voiceOverrides.what: A specific voice id to use on each engine. Empty = the closest voice of the same gender is picked automatically.
voiceOverrides.tip: Leave empty unless the automatic voice doesn't fit; paste the provider's exact voice id.

grokReasoning.label: Grok reasoning
grokReasoning.what: Grok only. "High" (xAI default) reasons before answering; "None" answers directly.
grokReasoning.tip: Try "None" if Grok's replies feel slow; the latency impact is still being measured.
